report: SOL DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Lateral menisküs posterior hornunda grade II dejeneerasyon, medial menisküs posterior hornunda grade III dejenerasyon izlenmiştir.Femur distali medial kondil düzeyinde hafif kemik iliği ödemi ile uyumlu sinyal değişiklikleri mevcuttur.Ön çapraz bağ ve arka çapraz bağ, lateral ve medial kollateral ligaman normaldir.Distal kuadriseps ve patellar tendonlar normaldir. Patella normal yerleşimlidir. Retinaküler devamsızlık yoktur.Patellar kıkırdakta yer yer bütünlük kaybı ve komşu kemikte kemik iliği ödemi ile uyumlu değişiklikler izlenmiştir (tip 4 kondromalazi ).Suprapatellar bursada sıvı artışı izlenmiştir.Tibia interkondiler tüberkulum eminensia düzeyinde subkondral milimetrik kist ve hafif kemik iliği ödemi izlenmiştir.Diz eklemini oluşturan kemik yapıların sinyal intensiteleri doğaldır.

Findings:  There is a minor knee effusion. There is complex tearing of the posterior body and horn of the medial meniscus. Normal lateral meniscus.  Normal ACL, PCL, MCL and LCL. Normal extensor mechanism.  The tibiofemoral and patellofemoral articular cartilage is relatively preserved. No evidence of cartilage loss.  
Conclusion: Complex tearing of the posterior body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus.

MRI ΑΡ ΓΟΝΑΤΟΣ ΤΕΧΝΙΚΗ Η εξέταση έγινε με ακολουθίες παλμών Τ1, πυκνότητας πρωτονίων με καταστολή του σήματος του λίπους και Τ2 βαθμιδωτής ηχούς . ΕΥΡΗΜΑΤΑ Παρατηρήθηκαν τα εξής: 1. Μηνισκοθυλακική αποκόλληση αναγνωρίζεται στον έξω μηνίσκο με ρήξη της οπίσθιας άνω ιγνυο μηνισκικής δεσμίδας και του μηνισκομηριαίου συνδέσμου. 2. Ρήξη τύπου "λαβής κάδου" (bucket handle) παρατηρείται στον έσω μηνίσκο με μετατόπιση του μηνισκικού υλικού στην μεσοκονδύλια εντομή. 3. Ολική ρήξη πρόσθιου χιαστού συνδέσμου. 4. Ολική ρήξη οπίσθιου χιαστού συνδέσμου με παλαιό αποσπαστικό, πωρωθέν, κάταγμα στην κατάφυσή του, στην οπίσθια επιφάνεια της κνήμης. 5. Παρατηρείται οιδηματώδης απεικόνιση του πρόσθιου κνημιαίου μυός ως επί κάκωσησης του εν τω βάθει περονιαίου νεύρου. 6. Ο οστικός μώλωπας παρατηρείται σε φάση αποδρομής (συγκριτικά με την προηγούμενη εξέταση), κατά τον έσω μηριαίο και έσω κνημιαίο κόνδυλο. 7. Μικρά ξένα σώματα παρατηρούνται ενδοαρθρικά.  8. Λέπτυνση παρουσιάζει ο αρθρικός χόνδρος του έξω μηριαίου και έξω κνημιαίου κονδύλου από την προηγηθείσα κάκωση. 9. Οπισθίως του ραγέντος οπίσθιου χιαστού συνδέσμου, αναγνωρίζεται γαγγλιακή κύστη 22x18x9mm.

In the medial compartment, the meniscus is not torn and there is no focal chondrosis or chondral injury. 
 The lateral compartment, there is longitudinal vertical oblique tear at the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus. There is no focal chondrosis or chondral injury. 
 The patellofemoral joint, the patellar and trochlear cartilage appears congruent without chondral lesion. The medial patellofemoral ligament is intact.  
 In the intercondylar notch, there is complete tear of the anterior cruciate ligament, at mid substance. The posterior cruciate ligament is intact.  
 There is grade II ligamentous sprain (partial tear) of the medial collateral ligament. The posteromedial oblique ligament is intact. The lateral collateral ligament complexes are intact. The extensor mechanism is normal.  
 No knee effusion is present. The surrounding musculature is normal. There is no fracture or bone contusion. - Longitudinal vertical oblique tear at the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus. 
 - Complete tear of the anterior cruciate ligament, at mid substance. 
 - Grade II ligamentous sprain (partial tear) of the medial collateral ligament.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Left knee pain
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Complex tear of the body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus with a dominant horizontal oblique component. Mild extrusion. No displaced fragments.
Medial compartment cartilage: Low-grade chondral fraying along the lateral aspect of the medial femoral condyle. No full-thickness cartilage defect.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: High-grade chondral fissuring at the medial patellar facet.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: Mild distal quadriceps tendinosis extends into the quadriceps continuation with mild overlying prepatellar bursitis.
Patella tendon: Mild proximal patellar tendinosis.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 8 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Multilobulated ganglion extends from the proximal tibiofibular joint capsule into the adjacent popliteus and soleus muscles. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1. Complex tear of the body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus with a dominant horizontal oblique component, mild extrusion, and mild medial compartment chondrosis.
2. Mild extensor mechanism tendinosis involves the quadriceps continuation with mild prepatellar bursitis.
3. Mild patellofemoral compartment chondrosis.
4. Multilobulated ganglion extends from the proximal tibiofibular joint capsule into the adjacent popliteus and soleus muscles.

ΜΤ ΑΡΙΣΤΕΡΟΥ ΓΟΝΑΤΟΣ ΤΕΧΝΙΚΗ: Η εξέταση πραγματοποιήθηκε με ακολουθίες Τ1 σε στεφανιαίο επίπεδο και PDFS σε τρία επίπεδα. Συνυπάρχουν ευμεγέθη οστεόφυτα στον έσω μηριαίο κόνδυλο. - Από τον έλεγχο του έξω διαμερίσματος παρατηρείται λέπτυνση του αρθρικού χόνδρου (ICRS grade II) και επιχείλια οστεόφυτα. - Φυσιολογικοί απεικονίζονται οι πλάγιοι σύνδεσμοι άμφω και οι χιαστοί σύνδεσμοι. - Από τον έλεγχο του εκτατικού μηχανισμού, παρατηρούνται λέπτυνση και σχισμές του αρθρικού χόνδρου στην έσω επιφάνεια της επιγονατίδας και του μηριαίου κονδύλου, με συνοδό υποχόνδρινο οστεομυελικό οίδημα (ICRS grade IV).  - Ελάχιστη συλλογή υγρού ενδοαρθρικά. Findings:  There is a small knee effusion. There is a tear of the posterior root of the medial meniscus with mild extrusion of the body from the joint. No other tears demonstrated. Normal lateral meniscus.  Normal ACL, PCL, MCL and LCL. Normal extensor mechanism. The tibiofemoral and patellofemoral articular cartilage is well maintained.  No evidence of patellar lateralization. No significant patellar or trochlear dysplasia. T T T G is however mildly widened and measures 17 mm. No evidence of high lying patella.  
Conclusion: Tear of the posterior root of the medial meniscus. Widened T T T G which could contribute to patellar maltracking.
